script: In 1957, America woke up to a strange beeping sound coming from the sky. The Soviets had secretly launched Sputnik, the first satellite ever built, and the whole country panicked. They thought Russia could now drop bombs from orbit. Then in 1961, the Soviets struck again, secretly training a fighter pilot named Yuri Gagarin and launching him into space before anyone even knew his name. He orbited the entire Earth and returned a hero, humiliating America completely. So the United States made an insane promise: land a man on the actual Moon before the decade ended. Nobody knew if it was even possible. On July 20th, 1969, Apollo 11 touched down, and Neil Armstrong stepped onto the Moon. America had won the most expensive bet in history.
